title: SM 6.2, five minutes before school, on Cursor with no log reader
story: The base timeline with its commit's server clocks and forge lookup. CC1 is not computable: Cursor has hooks but no v1 log reader (DESIGN 5.1), so there is no second record to compare.

items.why: no v1 log reader for this harness (DESIGN 5.1)

CC1.reason: no session of the submission has a v1 log reader

CC6.basis: Stated, not recomputed: the live buckets are pkg/score over this device's events.jsonl, which the reveal holds in full, so the server's re-score is the same computation and every minute reproduces.

CC11.reason: the typing module is off on this device

not_exercised.CC8: SM 6.2 doesn't quote the prompt, so there is no text to commit or reveal

notes: CC3: the commit's 29 + 13 lines against 41 recorded in its interval, the agent's 28 + 12 and her 1-line fix. The heartbeat Cursor sent for the agent's edit is edit_source agent, and counting it as well would give 81, which changes nothing here.

CC4: the laptop sent the commit with the batch sealed at the suspend; the forge lookup found it at 08:12:04 local, when she pushed at school. remind-bot has no GitHub App, so the push-time rule doesn't apply.
